g.text: Dedicated return: external contact -> RETURN_LOAD -> existing monitor 2 ohm shunt -> RETURN_DRIVER -> current-driver B_BR.

g.desc: Dedicated return: external contact -> RETURN_LOAD -> existing monitor 2 ohm shunt -> RETURN_DRIVER -> current-driver B_BR.

g.text: TMUX6208 is rail-to-rail at valid 24 V supply; powered-off, stuck-on, parasitic coupling and two-source shared tissue paths remain unqualified.

g.desc: TMUX6208 is rail-to-rail at valid 24 V supply; powered-off, stuck-on, parasitic coupling and two-source shared tissue paths remain unqualified.

g.text: A_ROUTER needs external terminal guard qualification before connection to A_BR. Internal enable-low is only a commanded off state.

g.desc: A_ROUTER needs external terminal guard qualification before connection to A_BR. Internal enable-low is only a commanded off state.

g.text: Do not bypass the monitor, add a second shunt, tie the two returns, or use recording REF/BIAS as a stimulation return.

g.desc: Do not bypass the monitor, add a second shunt, tie the two returns, or use recording REF/BIAS as a stimulation return.

g.text: DIGITAL RESEARCH CIRCUIT / RESTRICTED 24 V, 3 mA SOURCES / ARTIFICIAL LOADS ONLY

g.desc: DIGITAL RESEARCH CIRCUIT / RESTRICTED 24 V, 3 mA SOURCES / ARTIFICIAL LOADS ONLY

g.text: Sixteen selectable stimulation contacts, two dedicated monitored returns; command-level routing is not measured continuity or isolation.

g.desc: Sixteen selectable stimulation contacts, two dedicated monitored returns; command-level routing is not measured continuity or isolation.

g.text: Both bank D commons share A_ROUTER. EN0 = ROUTE_EN & !ADDR3; EN1 = ROUTE_EN & ADDR3. Addresses 000..111 select S1..S8.

g.desc: Both bank D commons share A_ROUTER. EN0 = ROUTE_EN & !ADDR3; EN1 = ROUTE_EN & ADDR3. Addresses 000..111 select S1..S8.
